auth.description:
**Host Url**: The VTEX store host (e.g `{{accountName}}.{{environment}}.com`)
**App Key** and **App Token**: To get your app key and app token, follow the steps below:
1. Go to your vtex account on **Account Settings** -> **Account** -> **Security**
2. Click on **Generate access key and secret**
4. Copy the access key as your **App Key** and the secret is your **App Token**.

get-product-by-id.name: get-product-by-id
get-product-by-id.description: Find a product in your catalog by it's id

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a single catalog product from a VTEX store by its numeric product ID. Use to look up product details when you already know the product ID. Read-only and idempotent.

create-product.name: create-product
create-product.description: Create a new product in your catalog

aiMetadata.description: Create a new product in a VTEX store catalog, requiring name, title, description, and an existing brand ID and category ID. Optionally pass a product ID to set it explicitly. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate product.

Update-product.name: Update-product
Update-product.description: Update a product in your catalog

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing catalog product in a VTEX store, identified by its product ID. Requires the full set of core fields (name, title, description, brand ID, category ID, department ID) since it replaces the product record. Idempotent: repeating with the same input leaves the product in the same state.

get-brand-list.name: get-brand-list
get-brand-list.description: Find all Brands in your catalog

aiMetadata.description: List all brands in a VTEX store catalog. Use to enumerate brands or to resolve a brand name to its ID before creating or updating products. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

get-brand-by-id.name: get-brand-by-id
get-brand-by-id.description: Find a Brand in your catalog by it's id

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a single brand from a VTEX store catalog by its numeric brand ID. Use when you already know the brand ID and need its details. Read-only and idempotent.

create-brand.name: create-brand
create-brand.description: Create a new Brand to your catalog

aiMetadata.description: Create a new brand in a VTEX store catalog; only the brand name is required. Optionally pass a brand ID to set it explicitly. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate brand.

update-brand.name: update-brand
update-brand.description: Update a Brand in your catalog

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing brand in a VTEX store catalog, identified by its brand ID. Replaces the brand record, so all core fields (name, site title, link ID, text, menu home, keywords, active, score) must be supplied. Idempotent: repeating with the same input leaves the brand in the same state.

delete-brand.name: delete-brand
delete-brand.description: Delete a Brand in your catalog by it's id

aiMetadata.description: Delete a brand from a VTEX store catalog by its numeric brand ID. Destructive and irreversible. Idempotent in effect: once the brand is gone, repeating leaves it absent.

get-category-by-id.name: get-category-by-id
get-category-by-id.description: Find a Category in your catalog by it's id

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a VTEX store catalog category. Pass a category ID to fetch that single category, or omit it to fetch all categories. Use to look up a category or resolve a category ID needed when creating products. Read-only and idempotent.

get-sku-by-product-id.name: get-sku-by-product-id
get-sku-by-product-id.description: Find a Sku in your catalog by a Product id

aiMetadata.description: List the SKUs (product variations) associated with a given product in a VTEX store catalog, identified by the numeric product ID. Use to enumerate a product's variants. Read-only and idempotent.

create-sku.name: create-sku
create-sku.description: Create a new SKU to your catalog

ProductId.description: ID of the product to be associated with this SKU

Name.description: Name the variation of the product

aiMetadata.description: Create a new SKU (product variation) in a VTEX store catalog, associated with an existing product ID. Requires the SKU name and packaging dimensions/weight. Optionally pass a SKU ID to set it explicitly. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate SKU.

create-sku-file.name: create-sku-file
create-sku-file.description: Create a new SKU File to your catalog

aiMetadata.description: Attach an image file to an existing SKU in a VTEX store catalog, identified by the SKU ID, from a publicly accessible image URL. Requires the image URL, name, and whether it is the main image. Not idempotent: each call attaches another image to the SKU.
List all clients (customers) registered in the VTEX store master data. Use to enumerate customers. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.
Retrieve a single client (customer) from the VTEX store master data by its client ID. Use when you already know the client ID and need its details. Read-only and idempotent.
Retrieve a single order from the VTEX store order management system (OMS) by its order ID. Use when you already know the order ID and need its details. Read-only and idempotent.

List orders from the VTEX store order management system (OMS) created within a date range, specified as from/to year (required) plus optional month and day. Use to find orders over a period rather than by a single ID. Read-only and idempotent.
